title: Track to a Target with Bloodhound
breadcrumb: Track to a Target with Bloodhound

blocks.html: Bloodhound locks a tracker onto a target and gives you live range, bearing and ETA as you close the gap.

slides.title: Open the Bloodhound tool
slides.html: Tap the Bloodhound icon to open the tool. The Setup Bloodhound prompt appears so you can choose your tracker and your target.

slides.title: Set tracker and target
slides.html:
Tap From Reticle to pick the tracker (defaults to your own Self-Marker), then tap To Reticle to pick the target.

  • The target can be another user, a DP, a CoT marker or any map point.
  • Use Quick Select DP to grab a DP fast.

slides.title: Activate the track
slides.html: Tap OK to activate. A green line is drawn from you to the target. If you tapped empty map instead of an object, Bloodhound drops a waypoint there and tracks to it.

slides.title: Read range, bearing and ETA
slides.html: The green widget in the lower-left shows live Range, Bearing and ETA. As either point moves and you navigate toward the target, these values update in real time.

slides.title: Watch the line colour
slides.html: The line flashes by ETA: green flashes at 6 minutes out, then 3 minutes, turns flashing yellow at 1 minute, and flashes red until you reach the target. Adjust these in Settings > Tool Preferences > Specific Tool Preferences > Bloodhound Preferences.
